newsitem.title: SENEGAL: At least eight killed in Senegal train crash.
newsitem.headline: At least eight killed in Senegal train crash.

text.p: At least eight people were killed on Sunday when three carriages of a train from Mali's capital Bamako to Senegal's capital Dakar jumped the rails and plunged into a ravine, officials said. A further 12 people were hurt.
Officials in the regional capital of Tambacounda said the accident occurred close to the remote village of Sinthiou.
"The three last carriages of the convoy became detached and plunged into a ravine, killing eight people on the spot," one official told Reuters by telephone.
